name: team_planning_history
description: List the history of a scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in, oldest first, 100 entries a page, with next_page true when another follows: every change it set, pin and clear it made, and every undo and redo of one, with who did it and when. action is set, pin, clear, undo or redo; an undo or redo names the entry it reverses in reverses_event_id. An entry that stands undone says who undid it. A change or pin shows the note it was made with as note: { value }, or { removed: true } once the plan is deleted. Any other value that can be erased is never shown here: sealed_fields names any such field. A forgotten person reads as "Former member". Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
